recipe.visualDefinition: A mid-century modern album cover featuring a full-body studio portrait of a male performer in a dynamic dance pose, set against a clean, off-white background with asymmetrical, multi-colored typographic blocks and a tracklist framed by a hand-drawn squiggly border.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned on the right third, leaning into the negative space on the left.
Title text at the top left balanced by the subject's head on the right.
Tracklist text blocks aligned to the left, creating a vertical column of information.
Color palette of the clothing (yellow/gold) contrasting with the primary blue and red text.
coreInvariants: Off-white or light cream solid background.
Full-body subject with a clear silhouette.
Heavy use of bold, condensed sans-serif typefaces.
Specific 'drop shadow' effect on the main title using a secondary color offset.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body figure occupies the right 40% of the frame, scaled to reach from near the bottom edge to the upper third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's yellow sweater acts as the primary color anchor, while the large red title serves as the typographic anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left title, moves down through the blue artist name, follows the subject's outstretched arm to the right, and settles on the tracklist at the bottom left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample open space around the subject and between text blocks to maintain a clean, 1960s modernist feel.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white background provides a neutral canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black trousers and dark hair provide grounding contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant yellow sweater, sky blue artist name, and tomato red title/tracklist.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation for primary accents against a low-saturation background.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Title features a hard-edged, flat grey drop shadow offset to the bottom right.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying weights and colors of the same sans-serif family to distinguish hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Hand-drawn squiggly line border for the lower tracklist section.
Small rectangular logo box in the top right corner.

preserve: Primary color coding for different text roles

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed feel of the main title.
Suitable for the secondary artist and tracklist information.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A full-body studio photograph of a man in a 1960s yellow pullover sweater and black trousers, captured in a mid-dance pose with arms outstretched, set against a solid off-white studio background. Leave the left half of the frame empty for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply bold condensed sans-serif text in the left half. Use red for the top title with a grey drop shadow. Use blue for the artist name below it. Add a tracklist in red at the bottom left, enclosed on the left and top by a thin black squiggly line.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid, warm off-white?
Is the subject's pose dynamic and full-body?
Are there three distinct text colors (Red, Blue, Black)?

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text does not overlap the subject.
Ensure the squiggly line border is thin and hand-drawn in appearance.
Verify the drop shadow on the title is a flat color, not a soft blur.
Confirm the background is a single solid tone.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a dynamic full-body portrait against a neutral wall, then apply a left-aligned typographic grid using bold, condensed sans-serifs in primary colors, ensuring the title has a flat offset shadow.
